name: runtrip-ai
description: Plan a trip day by day: timed stops with costs, an estimated total, and a link to view and share the plan. Built around your dates, flights and must-sees.

interface.longDescription:
Runtrip AI plans a trip day by day, right in the conversation. Tell the assistant where you're going, for how many days and where you're departing from. If you know them, add your dates, who is travelling, when your flight lands and takes off, the places you want to see, and your interests or pace.

Runtrip builds the plan with the same planner as runtrip.ai. Each day gets a title and timed stops, each with its cost, and the trip gets an estimated total for flights, stays and activities. Venues are checked against the days they are closed, and day 1 starts after your flight lands.

A plan takes one to two minutes. The card shows that it is being built and fills in when it is ready; the full plan also comes back as text.

Each plan is saved at an unlisted link on runtrip.ai, where you can view it and share it. A second link opens the trip in Runtrip's chat to refine it. The app plans at most 4 days of a trip; the result says how many of the requested days were planned, and the full trip can be planned on runtrip.ai. The number of plans per day is limited.

Runtrip receives only the trip details the assistant sends, never the rest of your conversation. It creates no account and sets no cookie.
capabilities: Plan a trip day by day with timed stops and costs
Save each plan at a shareable link
defaultPrompt: Plan a 4-day trip to Rome from London
Plan 3 days in Lisbon for 2 adults and a 7-year-old, flying from Berlin
Plan a long weekend in Kyoto for food and temples, flying from Seoul

positive.description: Full brief with a landing time and a must-see
positive.prompt: Plan a 4-day trip to Rome from London, starting next Saturday. We land at 17:05 and we'd love to see the Colosseum.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls plan_trip with { destination: "Rome, Italy", days: 4, origin: "London", startDate: <next Saturday>, arrivalTime: "17:05", mustSees: ["Colosseum"] }. If the result is planning, the card polls get_trip_plan (or the model calls it) until the plan is ready. Shows 4 days with timed stops and costs, day 1's first stop after the airport transfer no earlier than 18:05, the Colosseum in the plan, the estimated total, and links to the plan's page and to Runtrip's chat. Example run (ChatGPT, 2026-10-23): "Rome, Italy, 31 Oct – 3 Nov 2026", estimated total €836.

positive.prompt: Plan a 7-day trip to Barcelona from Paris for two adults.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls plan_trip with { destination: "Barcelona, Spain", days: 7, origin: "Paris", adults: 2 }. Shows 4 days and the line "Planned 4 of the 7 requested days. The full trip can be planned on runtrip.ai.", the estimated total and both links. Example run (ChatGPT, 2026-10-23): Barcelona, 13–16 Nov 2026, 4 of 7 days, estimated total €1,314.

positive.prompt: Planifie un séjour de 3 jours à Lisbonne au départ de Lyon, pour 2 adultes et un enfant de 7 ans.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls plan_trip with { destination: "Lisbon, Portugal", days: 3, origin: "Lyon", adults: 2, childrenAges: [7], language: "fr" }. Shows 3 days with day titles and stops in French, the estimated total and both links. Example run (ChatGPT, 2026-10-23): Lisbon, 13–15 Nov 2026, day titles in French, estimated total €1,317.

Asks which airport the trip departs from, then calls plan_trip with { destination: "Prague, Czechia", days: 3, origin: <the answer> } and shows 3 days, the estimated total and both links. Example run (ChatGPT, 2026-10-24): Prague, 14–16 Nov 2026, 2 adults, estimated total €653.

positive.description: Short trip with an infant and a return flight time, asked in German
positive.prompt: Plane 2 Tage in Wien ab München für 2 Erwachsene und ein Baby, ab nächstem Freitag. Unser Rückflug geht am letzten Tag um 18:30.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls plan_trip with { destination: "Vienna, Austria", days: 2, origin: "Munich", adults: 2, infants: 1, startDate: <next Friday>, departureTime: "18:30", language: "de" }. Shows 2 days in German, the last day planned around the 18:30 take-off, the estimated total and both links. Example run (ChatGPT, 2026-10-24): Vienna, 30–31 Oct 2026, in German, day 2 ending with the 15:30 transfer to the airport, estimated total €930.

negative.prompt: Book me a flight from London to Rome on the 5th of December.
Do I need a visa to visit Japan with a UK passport?
What's the weather usually like in Rome in December?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.
